evidence.quote: Still 9.7 percent of the workforce is unemployed and nearly 6 percent is working only part time while still seeking full-time employment.
For the moment, the contraction in consumer credit appears to be a story both of diminished supply and weakened demand.
Consumers will reengage slowly as confidence, income, and balance sheets strengthen.
Having survived the financial crisis, it is now time to work together to build a consumer banking model for the future.
